card.name: Inside biosynthesis and enzyme pathway terms
card.fires_on: Partway through long biochemistry words such as biosynthesis, decarboxylase and porphobilinogen, or on 'precursor' in metabolic pathway text. Seen mostly in levodopa, porphyria and cholesterol label text.

modes.label: Split enzyme or pathway words
modes.description: Middle piece of a long word like biosynthesis, decarboxylase or porphyria.
modes.example: Studies show that peripheral dopa decar<<box>>ylase is saturated by carbidopa

modes.label: Precursor of a compound
modes.description: The word precursor naming a chemical that a drug is made from in the body.
modes.example: Sapropterin dihydrochloride may increase the availability of tyrosine, a<< precursor>> of levodopa.

card.writes: It pushes toward chemistry and metabolism word endings such as oxid, metabolism, intermediate and product.
card.plain: It marks the middle of long biochemistry words about how the body makes or breaks down compounds.
